must_present.label: Sandstone desert mountains on the flats — not the volcano
Cactus voxel plants spread across the desert flats
Dry washes that fade out (no perennial through-river)
Sandstorm/dust particles over desert coordinates (not a legend string)
Placed arid animals (fox/rabbit class) in desert cells
Dead bush / dry scrub cubes on the desert flats besides cactus

must_not_present.label: Perennial river through the desert core or into the volcano (fading dry washes are allowed)
Lava or erupting volcano as the desert
Jungle, snowy pines, or lush grassland as the desert
Mangroves, lily pads, or beach palms as the desert core
